# Thai Open Transit

> Open, structured, versioned dataset of the Bangkok metropolitan rail network (Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani). The dataset is the product; the map on this site is a reference implementation of it. Data is ODbL-1.0, code is AGPL-3.0.

Key facts for working with the data:

- Every station and line carries `name_th` (Thai) and `name_en` (English, may be null).
- Entity IDs are stable forever. Station IDs (e.g. `BL15`) are not station codes; codes change over time and are kept in `code_history[]`.
- The data is temporal. `validity[]` and `milestones[]` hold dates; filter by date to get the network as of any day. `trial_run` and `opened` are distinct events.
- Every date has a `date_precision`: `exact`, `month`, `year` or `disputed`.
- Every milestone cites its sources in `source_refs[]`; every record has a `last_verified_at` date.
- Dates are ISO 8601 (AD). Coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

## Data

- [network.json](/network.json): stations, lines and segments, current state with full temporal fields
- [network.geojson](/network.geojson): the same network as GeoJSON features
- [stations.csv](/stations.csv): flat station list (id, names, structure, accessibility, lat/lon)
